## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The failure-report selector should normalize paths when matching requests; otherwise, it silently omits requested failures with a `./` prefix.

## Changes
The pull request adds selection from failure reports, refactors cached selection, and adds tests for all three selectors. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure paths when matching requests — For `report={"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}`, you return `[]` instead of `["./tests/test_x.py"]`. Direct membership skips the normalization that `select_explicit` uses for the same path. — Users rerunning a requested failed test silently omit it when the runner reports its path with a `./` prefix. — Fix: Match using `normalize(path) in requested`, preserve the original output spelling, and extend `test_failure_report_selection`.
